title: Error taxonomy

D0.outcome: Names the five error types (not seen, seen but miscalculated, misjudged, time pressure, out of book) and gives an example of each.

D1.outcome: Given annotated errors from his own games, classifies each tentatively and states the question that would confirm it.

D2.outcome: Classifies at least ten errors from three games, with two supporting observations each, and revises a label when new evidence contradicts it.

D3.outcome: Separates errors of process from errors of knowledge and says which kind each recurring error is.

misconceptions: Every error is a calculation error.
conditions: Labels are assigned tentatively, with questions to the learner.
contrasts: Treating the detector's tag as a diagnosis.
One game's worth of evidence called a pattern.
An error caused by a misclick or an interrupted session.
contrast_sources: product design: small samples mean 'worth checking'

soft_prereq_notes.PRA.SECURE.D1: complacency is one of the process errors
